scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @starhn87/jev-decisions && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-cli.mjs
scripts.setup: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.mjs agent install
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.mjs doctor
scripts.disable: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.mjs agent uninstall
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs packages/eval/*.test.mjs packages/reporting/*.test.mjs dist/*.test.js claude-mod/tests/*.test.js
